messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Silverstream private deploy cutover prep tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can SRE confirm KMS key ARN, cross-account role name, and whether audit logs will go to their central SIEM? @silverstream-sre

silverstream-sre: KMS ARN is arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:1122334455:key/ss-9f8e. Cross-account role: RedwoodDeployRole-Silverstream. SIEM endpoint: https://ingest.siem.silverstream.internal/api/ingest.

lee: network ask — egress rules need 10.10.0.0/16 -> 18.20.30.0/24:443 and allow NTP to 13.14.15.16:123. Also create internal DNS A record redwood-api.private.silverstream -> 10.10.2.21

jamal: audit logs bucket is s3://silverstream-logs-redwood. We prefer object lock OFF to allow lifecycle; retention 120d. Customer to confirm object lock change.

maria: FYI renewal flag: Silverstream on month 11 of trial; low-severity issues during cutover could impact renewal. tagging sales.

silverstream-sre: we will disable object lock and add lifecycle 120d prior to cutover. Note: KMS scheduled rotation in two days, we will postpone rotation until after cutover to avoid decryption issues.

deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run job dj-8822 for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z. Will post result here.

silverstream-sre: post-dry-run smoke: healthz ok, embeddings endpoint had 429 on first burst but recovered with retry. Logs snippet: "[2026-03-24T16:02:11Z] WARN 429 /v1/embeddings - rate limit; retry 1 -> 200" Ticket SS-412 opened to tune burst policy.

maria: thanks — please attach IAM trust policy once updated with ExternalId and we'll sign off. Also confirm bucket object lock status when done.

silverstream-sre: will post updates within 2 hours.
